text: I cannot stay here any longer; I cannot bear this. Good-night.” “Good-night, Austin.” The door shut, but in a moment it was open again, and Austin stood, white and ghastly, in the entrance. “I was forgetting,” he said, “that I too have something to tell. I have received a letter from Dr. Harding of Buenos Ayres. He says that he attended Meyrick for three weeks before his death.” “And does he say what carried him off in the prime of life?
